runtime_config.description: Runtime configuration for the batch execution.

properties.description: A mapping of property names to values, which are used to configure workload execution.
properties.security_impact: High. The properties map is used to specify the execution environment. If a dedicated service account and subnetwork are not defined here, the job will run with insecure default settings.
properties.rationale: To enforce a secure execution environment, the service account and subnetwork must be explicitly defined within the runtime properties.
